breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' scheme. The ground truth resolves this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the 'Strang splitting' method, thus resolving the inconsistency.
